title: Writing / Style / Italics
slide_intent: Distinguish titles from surrounding prose so readers can recognize the kind of work being referenced.
strategic_value: A single mixed example can help Duolingo keep citations readable without inventing a treatment for each title.
demonstration: One paragraph contrasts italicized book and magazine titles with quoted song and article titles.
practical_value: Identify the type of work before choosing italics or quotation marks.

reference_purposes.Application: The example combines a book, song, article and magazine in one sentence sequence.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Italicize books, magazines, films and music albums; use quotation marks for song and article titles.
